units: revenue/expenses/shares in billions; EPS and share prices USD

observations.near_chip_revenue_period: FY2027 and FY2028 COMBINED, up-to outlook, not annual floor or disclosed signed backlog value

tam.capture_note: $15B direct-chip target is roughly 15% of a $100B market, approximate cross-horizon comparison, with competing Arm licensees included.
No disclosed Arm revenue entitlement or adoption timetable; overlaps existing automotive/embedded markets.
About 7% annual TAM growth does not by itself generate 30–50% ARM EPS growth.

streams.economics: Contractual fee per chip or percentage of chip ASP; richer IP/CSS can raise content. Customer cloud revenue and capex are not ARM revenue.
streams.partners: AWS Graviton, Google Axion, Microsoft Cobalt, NVIDIA Vera/BlueField; customer designs can also compete with ARM direct silicon.
streams.status: Established; datacenter growth strong but consolidated royalty growth only 8% in latest quarter.

streams.economics: Design-access/subscription and delivery-linked recognition; not an independent annuity on top of royalties.
streams.partners: Semiconductor, hyperscaler and OEM licensees; counterparty amounts undisclosed.
streams.status: Established, lumpy, +50% latest quarter; monitor ACV/RPO and subsequent royalties.

streams.economics: Full chip revenue less manufacturing/packaging, engineering, selling and compensation. No extra internal third-party royalty.
streams.partners: Meta multigeneration co-development independently confirmed; OCI planned fall 2027; OpenAI, SAP, Cloudflare and Cerebras in announced ecosystem, without verified individual order dollars.
streams.status: Multiple-customer purchase orders reported; first commercial shipments planned Jan–Mar 2027.

streams.economics: Armv9, CSS for Mobile 2, SME2 and GPU capability increase licensable content; hardware performance is not automatically a higher contracted fee.
streams.partners: OPPO, vivo, Xiaomi, Google; KleidiAI/software framework integration supports adoption.
streams.status: Edge royalties roughly flat despite technology expansion; no separate software SaaS revenue assumed.

streams.economics: Zena CSS, safety/real-time CPU content and richer silicon per vehicle/machine; long design/validation cycles.
streams.partners: Tensor, NXP, Siemens, AWS and Unitree ecosystem participation; 80+ partners do not establish purchase orders.
streams.status: Physical AI royalties +50%; robotics revenue and timing not separately quantified.

common_assumptions.expense_treatment: Non-SBC operating expense includes ordinary chip R&D and SG&A; manufacturing and packaging included in chip gross margin. Aggregate SBC, employer tax and acquisition costs charged exactly once; no duplicate cash buyback or internal royalty.
common_assumptions.expense_anchor: $0.825B quarterly adjusted opex guidance annualizes to $3.3B; a hypothetical 14% four-year CAGR produces ~$5.57B. Rounded $5.6B is a scenario budget, not issuer guidance.
common_assumptions.exclusions_note: No modeled purchase-commitment losses, restructuring, discrete tax items or unannounced acquisitions; therefore GAAP-style, not comprehensive forward GAAP reconciliation.

unknowns: Quarter-matched absolute segment royalties and realized royalty per chip; no exact weighted bridge for the 8% consolidated royalty rate.
Individual counterparty order value, acceptance terms, cancellations and chip supply allocation.
Future diluted share count, SBC grant/vesting schedule, tax rates and full GAAP adjustments.
TAM estimates are management expectations; no independent market sizing audit or calibrated scenario probabilities.
Long-term analyst model assumptions are not available; this does not prove growth is absent from consensus.
Potential customer/channel conflict, RISC-V and x86 competition, Arm China exposure, supply/yield/packaging constraints and working capital can change outcomes.
